fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 does not convert Reed–Muller support mass into an approximation gap: completeness already pays for every bag coordinate, so polynomial absolute pseudosection mass need not dominate the polynomial baseline. The proposed single four-variable-bag test neither specifies the added selectors/rows nor tests logarithmic nonlaminar expansion; G15 affine threading remains unresolved.

Proposal 2 invokes large possible Graver elements, not a lower bound on every harmful fiber. Existing G5 kernel moves or the G13 affine collision can persist through linear layers via diagonal or cancelling copies, and r=Theta(log m) active layers alone gives only logarithmic mass while increasing the completeness baseline; the unspecified representative overlap is not a preregistered test.

Proposal 3 cannot enforce decomposability or Plücker relations with linear CVP rows merely by introducing tuple selectors. Linearized honest-compatible lifts also admit affine mixtures unless a proved mass bound excludes them, exactly the threat realized in G13 and G15; the proposed experiment does not define the lifted variables, rows, target, baseline, or unrestricted search certificate.

Proposal 4 supplies no explicit sheaf, restriction maps, formula embedding, or proof that legal global sections are separated from integral affine pseudosections. Cosystolic expansion concerns support of appropriate cochains and does not by itself make every zero-coboundary non-global selector expensive; the tetrahedral gadget is unspecified and cannot test the asymptotic mechanism.

Proposal 5's algebraic relation argument applies to direct coefficient polynomials, not to unrestricted signed multiplication-table pseudodistributions. Minimal-polynomial degree alone does not imply large coefficient mass, G13 defeats every compatible linear tag, and the proposed ring experiment leaves the multiplication lift, emitted coordinates, target, and exact search domain undefined.

Proposal 6 assumes an unavailable rank-one rigidity principle: rank one is quadratic and is not enforced by unspecified linear marker coordinates. No verified base CVP gadget with the claimed multiplicative ratio is identified, tensor CVP distance is not generally multiplicative, and enumeration restricted to {-1,0,1} cannot certify unrestricted CVP soundness.
evidence: No verifier evidence accompanies any Generation-20 proposal; every expected move is conjectural. The supplied status explicitly establishes no hardness lemma, composition theorem, or dimension-dependent gap.

G13 verifies that a constant-excess harmful selector is an exact integral affine combination of honest encodings and therefore annihilates every compatible linear hash. G15 verifies that this affine pseudodistribution threads an enlarged hierarchy with zero residual below its threshold.

G14 proves only a finite shell pass for one 520-selector pair-bag instance; it provides no fixed-level composition or growing-gap law. Proposal 1's suggested test is not a defined mutation of that emitted instance and would not establish logarithmic-bag behavior.

G5 finds short kernel moves in every tested private-row overlap composition, while G19 finds a constant-excess signed bypass in a substantially different global flow encoding. These results make unspecified linear consistency lifts presumptively vulnerable and require exact emitted constructions before authorization.
Past exact minima and shell exclusions are finite-instance facts only. None may be promoted to the polynomial n^c gap required by the target reduction.
